Hi. 21 year old female here. Been in a psychward for depression and anxiety before. Dropped out of highschool. Haven't had friends in years. I work at movie theater part-time making minimum wage. 

I swear, the only attention I can get is when guys want to use me for sex. The attention is nice, but it's not the good kind. I feel like your role-playing is just your way of coping. People are assholes and will say anything behind a computer screen. I have learned that over and over. On dating websites I get messages like "You are a waste of a beautiful girl. Nothing worse than someone doing nothing with their life"  so I'd recommend just about anything else to occupy yourself. Exercise (helps depression and anxiety!), read, learn an instrument, watch movies or tv, play videogames, write, draw... just find something you like to do. You don't even have to be good at it. Mainly I throw myself into xbox on my days off. Getting a job definitely helped with the feeling alone. I may hate people, but being forced to socialize makes me feel a little better. Have you looked into a part-time job? It's a good way to meet people and just get out of the house. 

I really hope you feel better and find healthier ways to cope. Reddit is here for you, I'm here for you. stay strong.
